title: PR 5A — inventory: items, purchases, on-hand (weighted average, integer-cents value)

goals.text: Accounts 1500 Inventory, 3900 Opening Balance Equity, 5990 COGS (US/CA) and 5995 Shrinkage are seeded in every chart pack (codes verified free); resolveAccountByRole maps inventory/cogs/shrinkage/opening_equity per jurisdiction (AU/UK cogs = existing 5000); taxCategory maps to Schedule C line 4 / T2125 8518 / ITR cost of sales / SA103; AU P8 closing stock reads the 1500 year-end balance and cost of sales is net of 5000+5995. Closing stock reads the jurisdiction's income-year end in UTC (AU 30 Jun; US/CA 31 Dec). Owner-call O3 deviation: UK runs on the US chart (5000 = Advertising) so COGS is 5990 until a UK pack exists.

Fake-ledger golden values: a bill line with itemId debits 1500 (never an expense) and adds qty/value (at_entry at entry, at_payment at payment; voids reverse exactly); WAC buy 10@$5 + 10@$7, relieve 5 -> $30 with 1500 always equal to the sub-ledger; value exactly 0 at qty 0 (333/334/333); negative stock then a purchase posts a stock_adjust true-up; opening stock balances to 3900; closed period -> 422 with nothing written; replay and a P2002 on the movement key -> one movement. Recoverable tax is netted out of stock value on both posting modes (2100 holds it); a negative adjustment cannot remove more value than is on hand; replays compare value.

Tenant-scoped {success,data} routes: items CRUD (409 duplicate_sku, cross-tenant ids 404, soft delete keeps movements), opening stock DR 1500 | CR 3900, adjust to 5995 at average cost with Idempotency-Key replay, movement ledger, low-stock list; bills accept itemId/qty on both posting modes and refuse a foreign item; writes need trackInventory (the flag, not businessType), toggled in Business Profile and offered only to the merchant/retail business types; inventory-role accounts never appear in expense pickers or auto-categorise suggestions.

Web Expenses > Items page (stock value, low-stock badge, opening/adjust/delete, localized 409), chat skill query-stock (registered before general-question, gated on trackInventory, computed qty/value, reply catalog in en/fr-CA/zh-CN), mobile Home low_stock alert linking to /app/chat?topic=low_stock; strings in en/fr-CA/zh-CN.

launch.rollback: Revert the PR. No schema change (5A.2 already merged; its tables/columns stay). The four chart accounts (1500/3900/5990/5995) stay on tenants that were back-filled and are unused. Any items/movements created meanwhile keep balanced journals (bill / bill_payment / stock_opening / stock_adjust) that ordinary void/reversal paths still undo; bill lines with itemId then pay as plain at_payment bills to the bill category (the 1500 debits already posted remain correct balance-sheet entries). Set trackInventory=false to hide the feature without a revert.
